body_lead: Hyderabad: The Telangana govt will address the highly rampant non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) using artificial intelligence (AI). This comes amid the widespread prevalence of the disease, backed by a survey conducted by the Asian Institute of Gastroenterology (AIG) this year, in which over 25% of people in urban areas and around 20% in rural areas were found to have fatty liver disease, leading to a sedentary lifestyle.
